GOOD TO KNOW

The little details.

What comes with a decor set?+

Each photograph shows the arrangement for that set. Confirm the final prop list with us before booking. Flower varieties, vase heights and selected props may vary with availability.

Do you decorate at home?+

Yes. We offer home decoration services. Share photographs or measurements of your space when discussing your enquiry so we can plan the setup.

How are rental prices and transport calculated?+

Request a quote for your chosen set, date and location. Rental duration, installation, takedown and transport charges will be confirmed before booking.

Is submitting an enquiry a confirmed booking?+

No. Your date is booked only after we confirm availability, the final arrangement and the booking terms with you.
